title: may / might / could — taxmin
recall: Taxmin darajalarini ayt: must, should, may, might, could, can't. Qaysi biri qanchalik ishonchli?
formula: must: deyarli aniq (bor) — He must be at home, the lights are on
may / might / could: balki (50% va undan kam) — It might rain later
can't / couldn't: deyarli aniq (yo'q) — That can't be Ali, he's in London

items.uz: Balki ertaga yomg'ir yog'ar.
en: It might rain tomorrow.
It may rain tomorrow.
It could rain tomorrow.

items.uz: U uyda bo'lsa kerak — chiroq yonib turibdi.
en: He must be at home — the lights are on.
He must be home, the lights are on.

items.uz: Bu Ali bo'lishi mumkin emas — u Londonda.
en: That can't be Ali — he's in London.
It can't be Ali, he's in London.

items.uz: Men kechikishim mumkin.
en: I might be late.
I may be late.

items.uz: U charchagan bo'lsa kerak — tun bo'yi ishladi.
en: She must be tired — she worked all night.
She must be tired; she worked all night.

items.uz: Balki u kelmas.
en: He might not come.
He may not come.

items.uz: Bu kalitlar seniki bo'lishi mumkinmi?
en: Could these keys be yours?
Might these keys be yours?

items.uz: Siz adashgan bo'lishingiz mumkin.
en: You might be wrong.
You may be wrong.
You could be wrong.

items.uz: U javob bermayapti — uxlayotgan bo'lsa kerak.
en: He's not answering — he must be sleeping.
He isn't answering; he must be asleep.
He isn't answering, he must be sleeping.

items.uz: Bu narx to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin emas — juda arzon.
en: This price can't be right — it's too cheap.
That price can't be right, it's too cheap.

items.uz: Kelasi yil boshqa shaharga ko'chishimiz mumkin.
en: We might move to another city next year.
We may move to another city next year.

items.uz: U haqiqatni aytayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.
en: He might be telling the truth.
He may be telling the truth.
He could be telling the truth.

items.uz: Jim bo'l — chaqaloq uxlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.
en: Be quiet — the baby might be sleeping.
Be quiet, the baby may be sleeping.

items.uz: Bu yerda qayerdadir do'kon bo'lsa kerak.
en: There must be a shop somewhere here.
There must be a shop around here.

items.uz: Ular hali yetib kelmagan bo'lishi mumkin.
en: They might not have arrived yet.
They may not have arrived yet.

items.uz: U shunchalik yosh bo'lishi mumkin emas!
en: She can't be that young!

items.uz: Imtihon qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, tayyorlan.
en: The exam could be difficult, so prepare.
The exam might be hard, so get ready.

items.uz: Sen hazillashayotgan bo'lsang kerak!
en: You must be joking!

items.uz: Bu xato bo'lishi mumkin.
en: This might be a mistake.
This may be a mistake.
This could be a mistake.

items.uz: U ishda bo'lmasa kerak — bugun yakshanba.
en: He can't be at work — it's Sunday.
He can't be at work, it's Sunday today.

speak: Rasmga qarab taxmin qiling: odam kim, qayerda, nima qilyapti? (must / might / can't)
Ertaga nima bo'lishi mumkin? 5 ta gap (might / may / could).
